movelist.name: Rock Tomb
movelist.effect: Rock Tomb lowers the target’s Speed by -1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Slam
movelist.effect: Slam may be used as a Free Action at the end of a Sprint Maneuver taken as a Standard Action, as long as the user Shifted at least 3 meters in a straight line towards the target. When used this way, Slam gains the Smite keyword.

movelist.name: Mimic
movelist.effect: Choose a Move that the target has used during the encounter. For the remainder of the encounter, that Move replaces Mimic on the user’s Move List. Mimic cannot miss.

movelist.name: Low Kick
movelist.effect: Low Kick’s Damage Base is equal to twice the target’s Weight Class.

abilities.name: Copy Master
abilities.effect: Connection - Copycat. Whenever the user uses Copycat or Mimic, it gains +1 Combat Stage in a Stat of its choice after the Move is resolved.

abilities.name: Mimitree
abilities.effect: Connection - Mimic. Whenever the user uses a Move copied by Mimic, they may choose to replace that Move with Mimic once more. When used this way, the user ignores Mimic’s Frequency.
